messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary cohort #3 showing spike in 5xx rate for /v1/generate (from 0.2% -> 7.8%) across us-west-2. Degraded tail latency observed. Paging oncall-sre.

alice: acked, I'm on it. Pulling up canary dashboard and recent deploy.

alice: confirm: deploy at 21:34 UTC today (commit 9f1c7b2) included the new batching heuristic + tokenizer change.

ben: that commit touched runtime batching + tokenizer shims. I can jump in. tagging @ben

charlie: seeing corresponding spike in error traces: "kv_cache_mismatch" in logs coming from runtime shard g-4. Sample stack: `Runtime::KVCache::get -> Tokenizer::lookup`

alice: @support-ops can you route any urgent customer reports to this thread? Need to know if external customers hit errors.

support-ops: got two incoming Support tickets referencing 500s for requests with long prompt chains. Both from enterprise customers on dedicated pools (eu-west). Marked high.

ben: ok reproducing locally with a stress script. When sequence length > 2048 + prefix the tokenizer returns -1 for some token ids -> runtime tries to use invalid KV keys -> 500. Looks like an off-by-one in the tokenizer patch.

alice: plan: 1) kill feature flag for new tokenizer (fast rollback path) 2) if kill fails, revert single commit to canary and roll forward patch. Which is faster?

ben: feature flag flip is fastest. Flag key: `tokenizer_v2_enabled`. I have credentials to flip.

ben: executing now: `curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/api/flags/tokenizer_v2_enabled -d '{"value":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****'`

incident-bot: JOB:flag-toggle started by ben at 2149001302. Audit id: FLA-3221.

ben: response: 200 OK. Flag state -> false.

alice: rolling metrics... dropping 5xx rate in canary?

charlie: preliminary: in us-west-2 canary cohort 3 5xx dropped to 1.1% in last 60s. Latency tail improved.

support-ops: customer tickets updated: both customers report decreased failures. Sending note that we're investigating root cause and toggled flag.

product-ops: heads-up — this feature was gated for canary only, not global. No user-visible regressions expected for others.

alice: good. But we need a permanent fix. Two options: patch tokenizer off-by-one and ship hotfix or revert commit 9f1c7b2 and reapply after tests. Which has lower risk?

ben: patch is small but touching tokenizer deserialization is risky. Revert single commit is quick and safe for deploy. I can prepare revert PR now: `git revert 9f1c7b2 --no-edit` then run canary CI.

dana: do we need an emergency release note or customer comms? Support suggests a short incident postmortem + notify affected customers who opened tickets.

alice: I'll own the rollback path + verification. ben, make the revert PR and attach the CI link. Charlie, keep monitoring metrics and traces. Support-ops take the customer comms draft.

ben: PR created: https://phabricator.redwood/rev/D12345 (revert 9f1c7b2). CI run started.

incident-bot: CI status: D12345 -> queued.

charlie: observability: adding a temporary alert to trigger if 5xx > 1% for 5m post-rollback.

alice: once CI passes, we'll promote revert to canary then production if stable. Who's on deploy window? I'm available for next 30 minutes then hand off. dana can you take on-call for follow-up?

dana: I can take handoff at 2149001900. I'll be monitoring for the next 4 hours.

ben: CI passed in canary stage. Promoting revert to canary now: `/deploy promote D12345 --target=canary --strategy=rolling`

incident-bot: DEPLOY started by ben at 2149002035. Deploy id: DEP-7812.

charlie: canary metrics: 5xx dropped to baseline 0.25% after deploy. No regressions in latency. Traces look clean.

support-ops: updating tickets: "We performed a rollback and toggled tokenizer_v2 off. Services are stable. We'll follow up with permanent fix and postmortem."

dana: taking handoff from alice now. Alice — any outstanding action items?

alice: thanks — just monitor for 1 hour, validate canary -> prod promotion if green, coordinate postmortem doc. I'll update runbook with exact rollback steps.

dana: ack. Adding entry to incident channel for the handoff.

incident-bot: Incident resolved (mitigation): feature flag toggled and revert deployed to canary. Severity: P2. Ticket: INC-2024-0456 created for postmortem.

product-ops: scheduling postmortem meeting at 08:00 PT tomorrow. Invite sent to eng-runtime, SRE, product, support.

support-ops: final note: two customers were impacted briefly; both satisfied with immediate mitigation but requested ETA for permanent fix. We'll coordinate follow-up.

ben: I'll prepare the safe patch and run extended unit + integration tests. Will link RFC with test plan to INC-2024-0456.

alice: thanks everyone. Closing Slack thread after on-call confirms no regressions.

dana: closing watch — no anomalies in last 30m. Good job team :thumbsup:
